arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَابَقَ بِالْخَيْلِ الَّتِي قَدْ أُضْمِرَتْ مِنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ وَكَانَ أَمَدُهَا ثَنِيَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ وَسَابَقَ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الَّتِي لَمْ تُضْمَرْ مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فِيمَنْ سَابَقَ بِهَا ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah held races among the horses that had been trained and made lean, from al-Hafya to Thaniyyat al-Wada. He held races among the horses that had not been trained, from the pass to the mosque of Banu Zurayq. Ibn Umar was among those who raced them.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْخَيْلُ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah said: Good is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي، الأَحْوَصِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ غَرْقَدَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الأَجْرَ وَالْمَغْنَمَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيَّ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya, Khalaf ibn Hisham, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah all report from Abu al-Ahwas. [Another chain:] Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Ibn Abi Umar both report from Sufyan. All report from Shabib ibn Gharqadah, from Urwah al-Bariqi, from the Prophet. They did not mention reward and spoils. In Sufyan's report, it says that Urwah al-Bariqi heard the Prophet.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ عَنْ بَعْجَةَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَدْرٍ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فِي شِعْبَةٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّعَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ خِلاَفَ رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
before: Qutaybah ibn Said narrated this to us, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim and Yaqoub (Ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qari), both from Abu Hazim, with this chain and a similar report. He said: Bajah ibn Abdullah ibn Badr. He also said: 'in one of these mountain passes,' differing from Yahya's narration.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي، طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ فَتُطْعِمُهُ وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ حَرَامٍ تَحْتَ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَأَطْعَمَتْهُ ثُمَّ جَلَسَتْ تَفْلِي رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَرْكَبُونَ ثَبَجَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ مُلُوكًا عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ أَوْ مِثْلَ الْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَشُكُّ أَيَّهُمَا قَالَ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ فَدَعَا لَهَا ثُمَّ وَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ فِي الأُولَى قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَكِبَتْ أُمُّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتُ مِلْحَانَ الْبَحْرَ فِي زَمَنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ فَصُرِعَتْ عَنْ دَابَّتِهَا حِينَ خَرَجَتْ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ فَهَلَكَتْ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah used to visit Umm Haram bint Milhan, and she would feed him. Umm Haram was married to Ubadah ibn al-Samit. One day the Messenger of Allah came to her, and she fed him. Then she sat and picked through his hair. The Messenger of Allah slept, then woke up laughing. She asked: What makes you laugh, Messenger of Allah? He said: Some people from my community were shown to me as fighters in Allah's cause, sailing on the back of this sea like kings on thrones—or like kings on thrones. The narrator was uncertain which of the two he said. She said: Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them. He prayed for her, then laid his head down and slept. He awoke laughing again. She asked: What makes you laugh, Messenger of Allah? He said: Some people from my community were shown to me as fighters in Allah's cause, as he had said before. She said: Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them. He said: You are among the first. Umm Haram bint Milhan sailed on the sea during Muawiyah's time. When she came out of the sea, she fell from her mount and died.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَّرَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ الشُّهَدَاءُ خَمْسَةٌ الْمَطْعُونُ وَالْمَبْطُونُ وَالْغَرِقُ وَصَاحِبُ الْهَدْمِ وَالشَّهِيدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: While a man was walking along a road, he found a thorny branch on the road and moved it aside. Allah appreciated this for him and forgave him. He also said: There are five kinds of martyrs: one who dies of plague, one who dies of a stomach illness, one who drowns, one who dies beneath a collapsed structure, and one who is martyred in the cause of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَّرَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Sumayy, the freedman of Abu Bakr, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: While a man was walking along a road, he found a thorny branch on it and moved it away. Allah appreciated this for him and forgave him.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عُلَمَائِنَا بِالْحِجَازِ حَتَّى حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ وَكَانَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ ‏.‏
before: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Idris al-Khawlani: that he heard Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade the eating of every fanged beast among beasts of prey. Ibn Shihab said: 'And I had not heard that from our scholars in the Hijaz until Abu Idris narrated it to me, and he was one of the jurists of the people of ash-Sham.'

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
before: And Abu at-Tahir narrated it to me: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Malik ibn Anas informed me with this chain of transmission the like of it.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَسْتُ بِآكِلِهِ وَلاَ مُحَرِّمِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya, Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated from Isma'il—Yahya ibn Yahya said: Isma'il ibn Ja'far reported to us, from 'Abdullah ibn Dinar: that he heard Ibn 'Umar saying: The Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was asked about the mastigure, and he said: 'I am not an eater of it, nor one who forbids it.'

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ سَيْفُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ وَخَالَةُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا ضَبًّا مَحْنُوذًا قَدِمَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا حُفَيْدَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ فَقَدَّمَتِ الضَّبَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يُقَدَّمُ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ حَتَّى يُحَدَّثَ بِهِ وَيُسَمَّى لَهُ فَأَهْوَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ إِلَى الضَّبِّ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ النِّسْوَةِ الْحُضُورِ أَخْبِرْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا قَدَّمْتُنَّ لَهُ ‏.‏ قُلْنَ هُوَ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ أَحَرَامٌ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ فَلَمْ يَنْهَنِي ‏.‏
before: Abu at-Tahir and Harmalah both narrated to me from Ibn Wahb—Harmalah said: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf al-Ansari: that 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas informed him that Khalid ibn al-Walid—who is called the Sword of Allah—informed him that he entered with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) upon Maymunah, wife of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and she was his maternal aunt and maternal aunt of Ibn 'Abbas. He found with her a roasted mastigure which her sister Hufaydah bint al-Harith had brought from Najd. She presented the mastigure to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)—and food was seldom presented to him without it being described and named for him. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) reached out his hand towards the mastigure, whereupon one of the women present said: 'Inform the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) of what you have presented to him.' They said: 'It is mastigure, O Messenger of Allah.' The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) raised his hand, so Khalid ibn al-Walid asked: 'Is mastigure unlawful, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'No, but it was not in the land of my people, so I find that I have a distaste for it.' Khalid said: 'So I pulled it towards myself and ate it while the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was looking on, and he did not forbid me.'

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ وَقَالَ إِسْحَاقُ سِتَّ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ سِتَّ أَوْ سَبْعَ ‏.‏
before: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, and Ibn Abi 'Umar all narrated it from Ibn 'Uyaynah, from Abu Ya'fur, with this chain of transmission. Abu Bakr said in his narration: 'seven expeditions,' Ishaq said: 'six,' and Ibn Abi 'Umar said: 'six or seven.'

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
before: And Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Quhzadh narrated it to me: Abdallah ibn Uthman narrated to me, from Abdallah ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus, from az-Zuhri, with this chain of narration, a similar narration.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
before: And Abu Salamah ibn Abd ar-Rahman narrated to me, from Abu Qatadah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), a hadith like this.

arabic: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَهُ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَلاَ فِي الْمُزَفَّتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الْحَنَاتِمَ ‏.‏
before: He said: And Abu Salamah informed him that he heard Abu Hurayrah saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Do not prepare nabidh in gourds, nor in pitched vessels." Then Abu Hurayrah would say: "And avoid green earthen jars."

arabic: قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ وَسَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْجَرِّ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ شَيْئًا يُنْتَبَذُ لَهُ فِيهِ نُبِذَ لَهُ فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ ‏.‏
before: Abu az-Zubayr said: And I heard Jabir ibn Abdillah saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade clay jars (al-jarr), vessels pitched with tar (al-muzaffat), and hollowed stumps (an-naqir). And when the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) found nothing in which to prepare nabidh for him, it was prepared for him in a stone bowl.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏"‏ إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَوَّلَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَحْضُرُ أَحَدَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Kurayb and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us, both from Abu Mu'awiyah, from al-A'mash, with this chain of narration: "When a morsel falls from one of you..." to the end of the hadith, and he did not mention the beginning of the hadith: "Indeed Satan is present with one of you..."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ، بِلاَلٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
before: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, Isma'il ibn Abi Uways narrated to me, Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to me, from Yunus ibn Yazid, with this chain of narration, similar to the hadith of Talhah ibn Yahya.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْقَزَعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ وَمَا الْقَزَعُ قَالَ يُحْلَقُ بَعْضُ رَأْسِ الصَّبِيِّ وَيُتْرَكُ بَعْضٌ ‏.‏
before: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Yahya—meaning Ibn Sa'id—narrated to me, from Ubayd Allah: Umar ibn Nafi' informed me, from his father, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade al-qaza'. He said: I said to Nafi': "What is al-qaza'?" He said: "Shaving part of a boy's head and leaving part of it."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ فِي الطُّرُقَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَنَا بُدٌّ مِنْ مَجَالِسِنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلاَّ الْمَجْلِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا حَقُّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَكَفُّ الأَذَى وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Suwayd ibn Sa'id narrated to me: Hafs ibn Maysarah narrated to me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata' ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "Beware of sitting in the pathways." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, we cannot do without our gatherings where we converse." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "So if you refuse but to gather, then give the road its due right." They said: "And what is its right?" He said: "Lowering the gaze, refraining from harm, returning greetings of peace, enjoining what is right, and forbidding what is wrong."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا فِي مَجْلِسٍ عِنْدَ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَأَتَى أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ مُغْضَبًا حَتَّى وَقَفَ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمُ اللَّهَ هَلْ سَمِعَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلاَثٌ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَكَ وَإِلاَّ فَارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ أَمْسِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي فَرَجَعْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُهُ الْيَوْمَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنِّي جِئْتُ أَمْسِ فَسَلَّمْتُ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ انْصَرَفْتُ قَالَ قَدْ سَمِعْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ حِينَئِذٍ عَلَى شُغْلٍ فَلَوْ مَا اسْتَأْذَنْتَ حَتَّى يُؤْذَنَ لَكَ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ كَمَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ لأُوجِعَنَّ ظَهْرَكَ وَبَطْنَكَ ‏.‏ أَوْ لَتَأْتِيَنَّ بِمَنْ يَشْهَدُ لَكَ عَلَى هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ يَقُومُ مَعَكَ إِلاَّ أَحْدَثُنَا سِنًّا قُمْ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ عُمَرَ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ هَذَا ‏.‏
before: Abu al-Tahir narrated to me: Abd Allah ibn Wahb informed me: Amr ibn al-Harith narrated to me, from Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj, that Busr ibn Sa'id narrated to him that he heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: We were in a gathering with Ubayy ibn Ka'b when Abu Musa al-Ash'ari came in anger, stood before us, and said: "I adjure you by Allah, did any of you hear the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: Seeking permission is three times; if permission is granted to you, enter, otherwise go back?" Ubayy said: "What is the matter?" He said: "I sought permission to enter upon Umar ibn al-Khattab yesterday three times, and permission was not given to me, so I went back. Then I came to him today, entered upon him, and informed him that I had come yesterday, greeted three times, and then left. He said: We heard you, but we were busy at the time; why didn't you keep seeking permission until permission was given to you? I said: I sought permission just as I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say. He said: By Allah, I will surely inflict pain on your back and stomach unless you bring someone who testifies for you to this!" Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: "By Allah, none shall stand with you except the youngest of us in age; stand up, O Abu Sa'id." So I stood up until I came to Umar and said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say this."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ مَعْنِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Harun ibn Abdillah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far narrated it to us, from Ma'n ibn Isa, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), with that.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَالِدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مَعْنِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جُوَيْرِيَةَ ‏.‏
before: Harun ibn Abdillah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far ibn Yahya ibn Khalid narrated to me, both from Ma'n ibn Isa, from Malik ibn Anas, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), in the sense of the hadith of Juwayriyah.

arabic: وَقَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ قَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ رَآنِي فَقَدْ رَأَى الْحَقَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: And he said: Abu Salamah said: Abu Qatadah said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Whoever sees me has indeed seen the truth."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: And 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us, from Jarir, from al-A'mash, with this chain of transmission, and he did not mention: "my companions, my companions."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ السَّكُونِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، - رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ - حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ إِنِّي فَرَطٌ لَكُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ وَإِنَّ بُعْدَ مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ كَمَا بَيْنَ صَنْعَاءَ وَأَيْلَةَ كَأَنَّ الأَبَارِيقَ فِيهِ النُّجُومُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ibn al-Walid al-Sakuni narrated to me, my father—may Allah have mercy on him—narrated to me, Ziyad ibn Khaythamah narrated to me, from Simak ibn Harb, from Jabir ibn Samurah, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), he said: "Behold! Indeed, I am your forerunner at the Basin, and indeed the distance between its two edges is like the distance between Sanaa and Aylah, with its jugs appearing like the stars."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ أَيْسَرَهُمَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
before: And Abu Kurayb and Ibn Numayr both narrated it to us from 'Abdullah ibn Numayr, from Hisham, with this chain of transmission up to his words: "the easier of the two." And they did not mention what followed it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ سَنَةً ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth narrated to me, my father narrated to me, from my grandfather, he said: 'Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah, from 'A'ishah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) passed away when he was sixty-three years old. Ibn Shihab said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab informed me of the like of that.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قِصَّةَ الشَّاةِ وَالذِّئْبِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قِصَّةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏.‏
before: And 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth narrated to me, my father narrated to me, from my grandfather, 'Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain of narration: the story of the sheep and the wolf, and he did not mention the story of the cow.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ نِسْوَةٌ قَدْ رَفَعْنَ أَصْوَاتَهُنَّ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ ابْتَدَرْنَ الْحِجَابَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
before: Harun ibn Ma'ruf narrated it to us, 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Muhammad narrated it to us, Suhayl informed me, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that 'Umar ibn al-Khattab came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) while there were women with him who had raised their voices over the Messenger of Allah (pbuh). When 'Umar asked permission to enter, they rushed to the veil... and he mentioned the like of the hadith of al-Zuhri.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ فِي الْمَعْنَى غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بِهَا لَمْ أَنْشَبْهَا أَنْ أَثْخَنْتُهَا غَلَبَةً ‏.‏
before: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Qahzad narrated it to me, he said: 'Abdullah ibn 'Uthman narrated it to me, from 'Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, with this chain of narration, the like of it in meaning, except that he said: "When I turned upon her, I did not cease until I subdued her completely in victory."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، فِي رِجَالٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقْبَضْ نَبِيٌّ قَطُّ حَتَّى يَرَى مَقْعَدَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُخَيَّرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَأْسُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي غُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَأَشْخَصَ بَصَرَهُ إِلَى السَّقْفِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الرَّفِيقَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قُلْتُ إِذًا لاَ يَخْتَارُنَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَعَرَفْتُ الْحَدِيثَ الَّذِي كَانَ يُحَدِّثُنَا بِهِ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقْبَضْ نَبِيٌّ قَطُّ حَتَّى يَرَى مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُخَيَّرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ آخِرُ كَلِمَةٍ تَكَلَّمَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الرَّفِيقَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth ibn Sa'd narrated to me, my father narrated to me, from my grandfather, 'Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me, he said: Ibn Shihab said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab and 'Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me among men of knowledge that 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet (pbuh), said: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used to say while he was healthy: "Never has a prophet been taken until he sees his seat in Paradise, and then he is given the choice." 'A'ishah said: When death descended upon the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) while his head was on my thigh, he fainted for a while, then regained consciousness and fixed his gaze toward the ceiling, then said: "O Allah, the Exalted Companionship." 'A'ishah said: I said, "Then he does not choose us." 'A'ishah said: And I recognized the statement that he used to narrate to us while he was healthy, in his saying: "Never has a prophet been taken until he sees his seat in Paradise, and then he is given the choice." 'A'ishah said: So that was the last statement the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) spoke—his saying: "O Allah, the Exalted Companionship."

arabic: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَدْ أَكْثَرَ وَاللَّهُ الْمَوْعِدُ وَيَقُولُونَ مَا بَالُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارِ لاَ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ مِثْلَ أَحَادِيثِهِ وَسَأُخْبِرُكُمْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ إِنَّ إِخْوَانِي مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ كَانَ يَشْغَلُهُمْ عَمَلُ أَرَضِيهِمْ وَإِنَّ إِخْوَانِي مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ كَانَ يَشْغَلُهُمُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ وَكُنْتُ أَلْزَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مِلْءِ بَطْنِي فَأَشْهَدُ إِذَا غَابُوا وَأَحْفَظُ إِذَا نَسُوا وَلَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمْ يَبْسُطُ ثَوْبَهُ فَيَأْخُذُ مِنْ حَدِيثِي هَذَا ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُهُ إِلَى صَدْرِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَنْسَ شَيْئًا سَمِعَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَسَطْتُ بُرْدَةً عَلَىَّ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ ثُمَّ جَمَعْتُهَا إِلَى صَدْرِي فَمَا نَسِيتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ شَيْئًا حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ وَلَوْلاَ آيَتَانِ أَنْزَلَهُمَا اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ مَا حَدَّثْتُ شَيْئًا أَبَدًا ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="159" aya_end="159"]{‏ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَا أَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالْهُدَى‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Shihab said: and Ibn al-Musayyab said that Abu Hurayrah said: 'They say: "Abu Hurayrah has narrated too much," and with Allah is the appointed meeting. And they say: "Why is it that the Emigrants and the Ansar do not narrate like his hadiths?" I will tell you about that: my brothers among the Ansar were occupied by working their lands, and my brothers among the Emigrants were occupied by trading in the markets, while I used to remain closely attached to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) for merely my bellyful, witnessing when they were absent and memorizing when they forgot. And one day the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Who among you will spread out his garment and take from this speech of mine, then gather it to his chest, for he will never forget anything he heard?" So I spread out a cloak upon me until he finished his speech, then I gathered it to my chest, and after that day I never forgot anything he narrated to me. Were it not for two verses that Allah revealed in His Book, I would never have narrated anything: {Indeed, those who conceal what We sent down of clear proofs and guidance...} to the end of the two verses.'

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ، سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ وَيَقُولُ اسْمَعِي يَا رَبَّةَ الْحُجْرَةِ اسْمَعِي يَا رَبَّةَ الْحُجْرَةِ ‏.‏ وَعَائِشَةُ تُصَلِّي فَلَمَّا قَضَتْ صَلاَتَهَا قَالَتْ لِعُرْوَةَ أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ إِلَى هَذَا وَمَقَالَتِهِ آنِفًا إِنَّمَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثًا لَوْ عَدَّهُ الْعَادُّ لأَحْصَاهُ ‏.‏
before: Harun ibn Ma'ruf narrated it to us: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated it to us, from Hisham, from his father, who said: Abu Hurayrah used to narrate hadith and say: 'Listen, O lady of the chamber! Listen, O lady of the chamber!' while 'A'ishah was praying. When she finished her prayer, she said to 'Urwah: 'Do you not hear this man and his words just now? The Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) would only narrate a hadith such that if a counter were to count it, he could enumerate it.'

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth narrated to me: my father narrated to me, from my grandfather: 'Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me; he said: Ibn Shihab said: Anas ibn Malik informed me that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Whoever loves that his provision be expanded for him and his lifespan be prolonged, let him maintain the ties of kinship.'

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ، بْنَ مَرْوَانَ بَعَثَ إِلَى أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ بِأَنْجَادٍ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَلَمَّا أَنْ كَانَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ قَامَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَدَعَا خَادِمَهُ فَكَأَنَّهُ أَبْطَأَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَعَنَهُ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ قَالَتْ لَهُ أُمُّ الدَّرْدَاءِ سَمِعْتُكَ اللَّيْلَةَ لَعَنْتَ خَادِمَكَ حِينَ دَعَوْتَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَكُونُ اللَّعَّانُونَ شُفَعَاءَ وَلاَ شُهَدَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Suwayd ibn Sa'id narrated to me: Hafs ibn Maysarah narrated to me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, that 'Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan sent some furnishings from his possession to Umm al-Darda'. When one night came, 'Abd al-Malik stood up at night and called his servant, but he seemed to delay coming, so he cursed him. When morning came, Umm al-Darda' said to him: "I heard you last night cursing your servant when you called him." Then she said: I heard Abu al-Darda' say: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Habitual cursers will not be intercessors nor witnesses on the Day of Resurrection."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ أَمَرَ بِإِحْفَاءِ الشَّوَارِبِ وَإِعْفَاءِ اللِّحْيَةِ ‏.‏
before: Qutayba ibn Sa'id narrated it to us, from Malik ibn Anas, from Abu Bakr ibn Nafi', from his father, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), that he ordered trimming the moustaches closely and leaving the beard.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رُبَّ أَشْعَثَ مَدْفُوعٍ بِالأَبْوَابِ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Suwayd ibn Sa'id narrated to me: Hafs ibn Maysarah narrated to me, from al-'Ala' ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Many a disheveled person turned away at the doors, if he were to swear an oath by Allah, Allah would fulfill it."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَبْثَرٍ ‏.‏
before: And Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali narrated it to us: Jarir informed me, from Mutarrif with this chain of transmission, similar to the hadith of 'Abthar.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ، أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ لَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، مَوْلَى غَطَفَانَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَدَغَتْنِي عَقْرَبٌ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ ‏.‏
before: And 'Isa ibn Hammad al-Misri narrated to me: Al-Layth informed me, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Ja'far, from Ya'qub, that he mentioned to him that Abu Salih, mawla of Ghatafan, informed him that he heard Abu Hurayrah saying: A man said: "O Messenger of Allah, a scorpion stung me..." similar to the hadith of Ibn Wahb.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ لَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْقُرَّاءِ وَأَهْلِ الْفِقْهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُسْتَجَابُ لأَحَدِكُمْ مَا لَمْ يَعْجَلْ فَيَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ رَبِّي فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِبْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn Layth narrated to me: My father narrated to me, from my grandfather: 'Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, that he said: Abu 'Ubayd, the freed slave of 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf—and he was among the reciters and people of legal understanding—narrated to me, saying: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "One of you will be answered so long as he is not hasty, saying: 'I have supplicated to my Lord, but He has not answered me.'"

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ أَبَا ضَمْرَةَ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ يَتَمَشَّوْنَ أَخَذَهُمُ الْمَطَرُ فَأَوَوْا إِلَى غَارٍ فِي جَبَلٍ فَانْحَطَّتْ عَلَى فَمِ غَارِهِمْ صَخْرَةٌ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ فَانْطَبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ انْظُرُوا أَعْمَالاً عَمِلْتُمُوهَا صَالِحَةً لِلَّهِ فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِهَا لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَفْرُجُهَا عَنْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ وَامْرَأَتِي وَلِيَ صِبْيَةٌ صِغَارٌ أَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَإِذَا أَرَحْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَلَبْتُ فَبَدَأْتُ بِوَالِدَىَّ فَسَقَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلَ بَنِيَّ وَأَنَّهُ نَأَى بِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ الشَّجَرُ فَلَمْ آتِ حَتَّى أَمْسَيْتُ فَوَجَدْتُهُمَا قَدْ نَامَا فَحَلَبْتُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَحْلُبُ فَجِئْتُ بِالْحِلاَبِ فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ رُءُوسِهِمَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُمَا مِنْ نَوْمِهِمَا وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَسْقِيَ الصِّبْيَةَ قَبْلَهُمَا وَالصِّبْيَةُ يَتَضَاغَوْنَ عِنْدَ قَدَمَىَّ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبِي وَدَأْبَهُمْ حَتَّى طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً نَرَى مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً فَرَأَوْا مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ لِيَ ابْنَةُ عَمٍّ أَحْبَبْتُهَا كَأَشَدِّ مَا يُحِبُّ الرِّجَالُ النِّسَاءَ وَطَلَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهَا فَأَبَتْ حَتَّى آتِيَهَا بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ فَتَعِبْتُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ فَجِئْتُهَا بِهَا فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهَا قَالَتْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَفْتَحِ الْخَاتَمَ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ عَنْهَا فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ لَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا بِفَرَقِ أَرُزٍّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى عَمَلَهُ قَالَ أَعْطِنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَرَقَهُ فَرَغِبَ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَزْرَعُهُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِنْهُ بَقَرًا وَرِعَاءَهَا فَجَاءَنِي فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَظْلِمْنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ قُلْتُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْبَقَرِ وَرِعَائِهَا فَخُذْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَسْتَهْزِئْ بِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَهْزِئُ بِكَ خُذْ ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرَ وَرِعَاءَهَا ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهُ فَذَهَبَ بِهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏
before: Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Musayyabi narrated to me: Anas—meaning Ibn 'Iyad Abu Damrah—narrated to me, from Musa ibn 'Uqbah, from Nafi', from 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: "While three persons were walking, rain overtook them, so they took shelter in a cave in a mountain. Then a rock fell from the mountain over the mouth of their cave, shutting them in. Some of them said to others: 'Look to righteous deeds you performed for Allah and supplicate Allah, Exalted is He, by them, so that perhaps Allah will relieve you from it.' One of them said: 'O Allah, I had two aged parents, a wife, and young children for whom I used to shepherd [flocks]. When I brought them back to rest in the evening, I milked [the herd] and began with my parents, giving them milk to drink before my children. One day the search for pasture took me far away, so I did not return until evening and found them both asleep. I milked as I used to milk and brought the milking vessel, standing by their heads; I disliked waking them from their sleep, and I disliked giving milk to the children before them, while the children were crying at my feet. That remained my condition and theirs until dawn broke. If You know that I did that seeking Your Countenance, then open for us an opening through which we may see the sky.' So Allah opened an opening for them through which they saw the sky. Another said: 'O Allah, I had a female cousin whom I loved as passionately as men love women. I sought her intimate favors, but she refused unless I brought her one hundred dinars. I toiled until I gathered one hundred dinars and brought them to her. When I sat between her legs, she said: "O servant of Allah, fear Allah, and do not break the seal except lawfully." So I stood up from her. If You know that I did that seeking Your Countenance, then open for us an opening.' So He opened [it further] for them. And the other said: 'O Allah, I had hired a laborer for a faraq of rice. When he finished his work, he said: "Give me my due." I offered him his faraq, but he turned away from it. I kept cultivating it until I amassed from it cattle and their herdsmen. Then he came to me and said: "Fear Allah, and do not wrong me of my due." I said: "Go to those cattle and their herdsmen and take them." He said: "Fear Allah and do not mock me." I said: "I am not mocking you; take those cattle and their herdsmen." So he took them and went away with them. If You know that I did that seeking Your Countenance, then open for us what remains.' So Allah opened what remained."

arabic: قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ شَىْءٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya said: And Abu Salamah narrated to me that 'Urwah ibn al-Zubayr narrated to him that Asma' bint Abi Bakr narrated to him that she heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "There is nothing possessing more protective jealousy than Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى الأَرْضَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ بِيَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ مُلُوكُ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Yunus reported to me, from Ibn Shihab: Ibn al-Musayyab narrated to me that Abu Hurayrah used to say that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Allah, Blessed and Exalted, will seize the earth on the Day of Resurrection and roll up the sky in His Right Hand, then He will say: 'I am the King! Where are the kings of the earth?'"

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَكُونُ الأَرْضُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ خُبْزَةً وَاحِدَةً يَكْفَؤُهَا الْجَبَّارُ بِيَدِهِ كَمَا يَكْفَأُ أَحَدُكُمْ خُبْزَتَهُ فِي السَّفَرِ نُزُلاً لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ بَارَكَ الرَّحْمَنُ عَلَيْكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِنُزُلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ تَكُونُ الأَرْضُ خُبْزَةً وَاحِدَةً - كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ قَالَ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِإِدَامِهِمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِدَامُهُمْ بَالاَمُ وَنُونٌ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا هَذَا قَالَ ثَوْرٌ وَنُونٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ زَائِدَةِ كَبِدِهِمَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا ‏.‏
before: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth narrated to me: My father narrated to me, from my grandfather: Khalid ibn Yazid narrated to me, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from 'Ata' ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "On the Day of Resurrection, the earth will be like a single loaf of bread, which the Compeller will turn in His Hand just as one of you turns his loaf of bread while traveling, as hospitality for the people of Paradise." He said: A man from the Jews came and said: "May the Most Merciful bless you, O Abu al-Qasim! Shall I not inform you of the hospitality of the people of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection?" He said: "Yes." He said: "The earth will be like a single loaf of bread"—just as the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said. He said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, looked at us and then laughed until his premolars showed. The Jew said: "Shall I not inform you of their condiment?" He said: "Yes." He said: "Their condiment will be Balam and Nun." They asked: "What is that?" He said: "An ox and a giant fish, from the extra lobe of whose livers seventy thousand will eat."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الْقَيْسِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نُعَيْمُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ هَلْ يُعَفِّرُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَجْهَهُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ قَالَ فَقِيلَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللاَّتِ وَالْعُزَّى لَئِنْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ لأَطَأَنَّ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ أَوْ لأُعَفِّرَنَّ وَجْهَهُ فِي التُّرَابِ - قَالَ - فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي زَعَمَ لِيَطَأَ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ - قَالَ - فَمَا فَجِئَهُمْ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يَنْكِصُ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ وَيَتَّقِي بِيَدَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَقِيلَ لَهُ مَا لَكَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ لَخَنْدَقًا مِنْ نَارٍ وَهَوْلاً وَأَجْنِحَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ دَنَا مِنِّي لاَخْتَطَفَتْهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عُضْوًا عُضْوًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لاَ نَدْرِي فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَوْ شَىْءٌ بَلَغَهُ ‏[quran sura="96" aya_start="6" aya_end="14"]{‏ كَلاَّ إِنَّ الإِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَى * أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنَى * إِنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَى * أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَى * عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّى * أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى * أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَى * أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى‏}‏ - يَعْنِي أَبَا جَهْلٍ - [quran sura="96" aya_start="14" aya_end="19"]‏{‏ أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَى * كَلاَّ لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ * نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ * فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ * سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ * كَلاَّ لاَ تُطِعْهُ‏}‏ زَادَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ وَأَمَرَهُ بِمَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ يَعْنِي قَوْمَهُ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayrah said: Abu Jahl said: "Does Muhammad dust his face in the dust in front of you?" It was said: "Yes." He said: "By al-Lat and al-'Uzza, if I see him doing that, I will certainly trample upon his neck, or I will smear his face in the dust!" He said: So he came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, while he was praying, intending to trample upon his neck. He said: Nothing surprised them from him except that he was turning back on his heels and shielding himself with his hands. He said: It was said to him: "What is the matter with you?" He said: "Indeed, between me and him is a trench of fire, terror, and wings." The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "If he had drawn near to me, the angels would have snatched him limb by limb." He said: Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed—we do not know whether it is in the hadith of Abu Hurayrah or something that reached him: {"No! Indeed, man transgresses, because he sees himself self-sufficient. Indeed, to your Lord is the return. Have you seen the one who forbids a servant when he prays? Have you seen if he is upon guidance, or enjoins righteousness? Have you seen if he denies and turns away"}—meaning Abu Jahl—{"Does he not know that Allah sees? No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock—a lying, sinning forelock. Then let him call his associates; We will call the angels of Hell. No! Do not obey him"}. 'Ubaydullah added in his hadith: he said: and He commanded him with what He commanded him with. And Ibn 'Abd al-A'la added: "Then let him call his associates"—meaning his people.

arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جُلُوسًا وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ بَيْنَنَا فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّ قَاصًّا عِنْدَ أَبْوَابِ كِنْدَةَ يَقُصُّ وَيَزْعُمُ أَنَّ آيَةَ الدُّخَانِ تَجِيءُ فَتَأْخُذُ بِأَنْفَاسِ الْكُفَّارِ وَيَأْخُذُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ كَهَيْئَةِ الزُّكَامِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَجَلَسَ وَهُوَ غَضْبَانُ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَنْ عَلِمَ مِنْكُمْ شَيْئًا فَلْيَقُلْ بِمَا يَعْلَمُ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْلَمُ لأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ لِمَا لاَ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏[quran sura="38" aya_start="86" aya_end="86"]{‏ قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ‏}‏ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا رَأَى مِنَ النَّاسِ إِدْبَارًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ سَبْعٌ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَصَّتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْجُلُودَ وَالْمَيْتَةَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ وَيَنْظُرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَرَى كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ فَأَتَاهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّكَ جِئْتَ تَأْمُرُ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ وَبِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَإِنَّ قَوْمَكَ قَدْ هَلَكُوا فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُمْ - قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏[quran sura="44" aya_start="10" aya_end="11"]{‏ فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ * يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏[quran sura="44" aya_start="15" aya_end="15"]{‏ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَفَيُكْشَفُ عَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ ‏[quran sura="44" aya_start="16" aya_end="16"]{‏ يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ‏}‏ فَالْبَطْشَةُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَقَدْ مَضَتْ آيَةُ الدُّخَانِ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَاللِّزَامُ وَآيَةُ الرُّومِ ‏.‏
before: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim reported to us: Jarir reported to us, from Mansur, from Abu ad-Duha, from Masruq, who said: We were sitting with 'Abdullah while he was reclining among us, when a man came to him and said: "O Abu 'Abd ar-Rahman, indeed a story-teller at the gates of Kindah is reciting stories and claims that the sign of the smoke will come and seize the breaths of the disbelievers, while it will afflict the believers only like a cold." 'Abdullah sat up angrily and said: "O people, fear Allah! Whoever among you knows something, let him speak according to what he knows, and whoever does not know, let him say: 'Allah knows best,' for indeed it is more knowledgeable for one of you to say about that which he does not know: 'Allah knows best.' Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said to His Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him: {'Say, "I do not ask you for it any reward, and I am not of the pretentious"'}. Indeed, when the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, saw the turning away of the people, he said: 'O Allah, seven years like the seven of Yusuf.' So they were seized by a year that devastated everything until they ate skins and dead animals out of hunger, and one of them would look up at the sky and see something like smoke. Then Abu Sufyan came to him and said: 'O Muhammad, you came commanding obedience to Allah and keeping ties of kinship, and indeed your people have perished, so supplicate to Allah for them.' Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: {'Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke, covering the people; this is a painful torment'}, up to His words: {'indeed, you will return [to disbelief]'}. He said: 'Will the punishment of the Hereafter be removed?' {'The Day We will seize them with the greatest seizure; indeed, We will take retribution'}—and the greatest seizure was the Day of Badr. And the sign of the smoke, the violent seizure, the inevitable punishment, and the sign of the Romans have already passed."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى كَعْبَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى حُجْزَتِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى تَرْقُوَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: 'Amr ibn Zurarah narrated to me: 'Abd al-Wahhab—meaning Ibn 'Ata'—reported to us, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, who said: I heard Abu Nadrah narrate from Samurah ibn Jundab that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Among them are those whom the Fire will seize up to their ankles, among them are those whom the Fire will seize up to their knees, among them are those whom the Fire will seize up to their waist-wrapper level, and among them are those whom the Fire will seize up to their collarbones."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا وُضِعَ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُ أَصْحَابُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ‏.‏
before: 'Amr ibn Zurarah narrated to me: 'Abd al-Wahhab—meaning Ibn 'Ata'—reported to us, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "When the servant is placed in his grave and his companions turn away from him..." and he mentioned the like of the hadith of Shayban from Qatadah.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ، الأَسْوَدِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ هَلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي يُونُسَ ‏.‏
before: 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Bishr narrated to me: Yahya—namely al-Qattan—narrated to me, from 'Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from 'A'ishah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "Whoever is called to a detailed reckoning will perish." Then he mentioned the like of the hadith of Abu Yunus.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ عَذَابًا أَصَابَ الْعَذَابُ مَنْ كَانَ فِيهِمْ ثُمَّ بُعِثُوا عَلَى أَعْمَالِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Harmalah ibn Yahya at-Tujibi narrated to me: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Yunus reported to me, from Ibn Shihab: Hamzah ibn 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar reported to me that 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "When Allah wills punishment for a people, the punishment afflicts whoever is among them, then they are resurrected according to their deeds."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّهُ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shayba, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to us, all from Ibn Uyayna, from al-Zuhri, with this chain. He said: He called for water and sprinkled it over him.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَزِعًا مُحْمَرًّا وَجْهُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَبِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَلَّقَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ الإِبْهَامِ وَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Yunus reported to me, from Ibn Shihab: 'Urwah ibn az-Zubayr reported to me that Zaynab bint Abi Salamah reported to him that Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan reported to her that Zaynab bint Jahsh, the wife of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: One day the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, went out agitated, his face flushed red, saying: "There is no god but Allah! Woe to the Arabs from an evil that has drawn near! Today, a hole like this has been opened in the barrier of Gog and Magog." And he made a circle with his thumb and the finger next to it. She said: I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, shall we be destroyed while the righteous are among us?" He said: "Yes, when wickedness becomes widespread."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ انْطَلَقَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَهْطٍ قِبَلَ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ حَتَّى وَجَدَهُ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ عِنْدَ أُطُمِ بَنِي مَغَالَةَ وَقَدْ قَارَبَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحُلُمَ فَلَمْ يَشْعُرْ حَتَّى ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ظَهْرَهُ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاِبْنِ صَيَّادٍ ‏"‏ أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ الأُمِّيِّينَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَرَفَضَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَبِرُسُلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَاذَا تَرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ يَأْتِينِي صَادِقٌ وَكَاذِبٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خُلِّطَ عَلَيْكَ الأَمْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي قَدْ خَبَأْتُ لَكَ خَبِيئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ ‏"‏ هُوَ الدُّخُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اخْسَأْ فَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ قَدْرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ذَرْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنْ يَكُنْهُ فَلَنْ تُسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْهُ فَلاَ خَيْرَ لَكَ فِي قَتْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ انْطَلَقَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ إِلَى النَّخْلِ الَّتِي فِيهَا ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّخْلَ طَفِقَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَهُوَ يَخْتِلُ أَنْ يَسْمَعَ مِنِ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ شَيْئًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرَاهُ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ عَلَى فِرَاشٍ فِي قَطِيفَةٍ لَهُ فِيهَا زَمْزَمَةٌ فَرَأَتْ أُمُّ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ فَقَالَتْ لاِبْنِ صَيَّادٍ يَا صَافِ - وَهُوَ اسْمُ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ - هَذَا مُحَمَّدٌ ‏.‏ فَثَارَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ تَرَكَتْهُ بَيَّنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّاسِ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأُنْذِرُكُمُوهُ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُ قَوْمَهُ لَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُ نُوحٌ قَوْمَهُ وَلَكِنْ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ فِيهِ قَوْلاً لَمْ يَقُلْهُ نَبِيٌّ لِقَوْمِهِ تَعَلَّمُوا أَنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ حَذَّرَ النَّاسَ الدَّجَّالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ يَقْرَؤُهُ مَنْ كَرِهَ عَمَلَهُ أَوْ يَقْرَؤُهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَلَّمُوا أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَرَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ رَبَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Harmalah ibn Yahya ibn 'Abdullah ibn Harmalah ibn 'Imran at-Tujibi narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed me: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn 'Abdullah, who informed him that 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar informed him that 'Umar ibn al-Khattab set out with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) in a group of people towards Ibn Sayyad, until he found him playing with boys near the fortress of Banu Maghalah, and Ibn Sayyad was at that time approaching puberty. He did not notice until the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) struck him on the back with his hand, then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to Ibn Sayyad: 'Do you testify that I am the Messenger of Allah?' Ibn Sayyad looked at him and said: 'I testify that you are the messenger of the unlettered.' Then Ibn Sayyad said to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): 'Do you testify that I am the messenger of Allah?' But the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) rejected him and said: 'I believe in Allah and in His messengers.' Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: 'What do you see?' Ibn Sayyad said: 'There comes to me a truthful one and a liar.' The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: 'The matter has become confused to you.' Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: 'I have concealed something for you.' Ibn Sayyad said: 'It is ad-Dukh.' So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: 'Be off with you! You will never exceed your station!' Thereupon 'Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'Leave me, O Messenger of Allah, to strike his neck!' But the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: 'If he is he, you will not be given power over him; and if he is not he, there is no good for you in killing him.' And Salim ibn 'Abdullah said: I heard 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar saying: After that, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and Ubayy ibn Ka'b al-Ansari set out towards the date palms where Ibn Sayyad was. When the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) entered the date palms, he began shielding himself behind the trunks of the date palms, seeking to hear something from Ibn Sayyad before Ibn Sayyad could see him. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saw him lying upon a bed in a velvet cloak of his, murmuring unintelligibly from within it. But the mother of Ibn Sayyad saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) while he was shielding himself behind the date palm trunks, so she said to Ibn Sayyad: 'O Saf'—and that was Ibn Sayyad's name—'Here is Muhammad!' Thereupon Ibn Sayyad jumped up, so the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'If she had left him alone, he would have made it clear.' Salim said: 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar said: Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) stood up among the people and praised Allah with what He is worthy of, then mentioned the Dajjal and said: 'Indeed, I warn you of him; there has been no prophet except that he warned his people of him. Nuh certainly warned his people of him, but I will say to you concerning him a statement that no prophet has ever said to his people: know that he is one-eyed, and that Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, is not one-eyed.' Ibn Shihab said: 'Umar ibn Thabit al-Ansari informed me that some companions of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) informed him that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said on the day he warned the people of the Dajjal: 'Indeed, written between his eyes is Kafir, which whoever despises his deeds will read—or every believer will read.' And he said: 'Know that none of you will ever see his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, until he dies.'

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ تُصِيبُهُ جَنَابَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَوَضَّأْ وَاغْسِلْ ذَكَرَكَ ثُمَّ نَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to me. He said: I read to Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar, who said: Umar ibn al-Khattab mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) that major ritual impurity befell him during the night. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to him: Perform wudu, wash your private part, and then sleep.

arabic: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ قَارِظٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، وَجَدَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَتَوَضَّأُ عَلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ أَثْوَارِ أَقِطٍ أَكَلْتُهَا لأَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ تَوَضَّئُوا مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Shihab said: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz informed me that Abdullah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz informed him that he found Abu Hurayra performing wudu at the mosque. He said: I am performing wudu only because I ate pieces of dried curd, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Perform wudu because of what the fire has touched.

arabic: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، وَأَنَا أُحَدِّثُهُ، هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ، مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ فَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَوَضَّئُوا مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Shihab said: Said ibn Khalid ibn Amr ibn Uthman, while I was narrating this hadith to him, informed me that he asked Urwa ibn al-Zubayr about wudu because of what the fire has touched. Urwa said: I heard Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Perform wudu because of what the fire has touched.

arabic: قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَحَدَّثَنِي بُكَيْرُ بْنُ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ عِنْدَهَا كَتِفًا ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏
before: Amr said: Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj narrated to me, from Kurayb, the client of Ibn Abbas, from Maymuna, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), that the Prophet (peace be upon him) ate a shoulder at her house, then prayed without performing wudu.

arabic: قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Amr said: Jafar ibn Rabia narrated to me, from Yaqob ibn al-Ashajj, from Kurayb, the client of Ibn Abbas, from Maymuna, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.

arabic: قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي غَطَفَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ أَشْهَدُ لَكُنْتُ أَشْوِي لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَطْنَ الشَّاةِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏
before: Amr said: Said ibn Abi Hilal narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Abi Rafi, from Abu Ghutfan, from Abu Rafi, who said: I testify that I used to roast the belly of a sheep for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). Then he prayed without performing wudu.

arabic: قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَرَوَى اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ أَقْبَلْتُ أَنَا وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، مَوْلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي الْجَهْمِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الصِّمَّةِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ فَقَالَ أَبُو الْجَهْمِ أَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نَحْوِ بِئْرِ جَمَلٍ فَلَقِيَهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى أَقْبَلَ عَلَى الْجِدَارِ فَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ ‏.‏
before: Muslim said: al-Layth ibn Sad narrated from Jafar ibn Rabia, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz, from Umayr, the client of Ibn Abbas, that he heard him say: I and Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasar, the client of Maymuna, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), went until we entered upon Abu al-Jahm ibn al-Harith ibn al-Simma al-Ansari. Abu al-Jahm said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came from the direction of the Well of Jamal. A man met him and greeted him, but the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) did not return his greeting until he came to a wall, wiped his face and hands, and then returned the greeting.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُجْمِرِ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، - وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ هُوَ الَّذِي كَانَ أُرِيَ النِّدَاءَ بِالصَّلاَةِ - أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ فِي مَجْلِسِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ بَشِيرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ أَمَرَنَا اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَكَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْنَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْأَلْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُولُوا ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ‏.‏ وَالسَّلاَمُ كَمَا قَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi said: I read to Malik, from Nuaim ibn Abdullah al-Mujmir, that Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zayd al-Ansari, and Abdullah ibn Zayd was the one who was shown the call to prayer, informed him from Abu Masud al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came to us while we were at the gathering of Sad ibn Ubada. Bashir ibn Sad said to him: Allah the Exalted has commanded us to invoke blessings upon you, O Messenger of Allah. How should we invoke blessings upon you? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) remained silent until we wished he had not asked him. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Say: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed the family of Ibrahim, and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed the family of Ibrahim among the worlds. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. And the greeting, as you have already learned.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When the imam says, “Allah hears whoever praises Him,” say, “O Allah, our Lord, to You belongs praise.” Whoever’s words coincide with the words of the angels will have his previous sins forgiven.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُمَا أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَمَّنَ الإِمَامُ فَأَمِّنُوا فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ آمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Said ibn al-Musayyab and Abu Salama ibn Abd al-Rahman, that they informed him from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When the imam says, “Amin,” say, “Amin.” Whoever’s saying of Amin coincides with the saying of the angels will have his previous sins forgiven. Ibn Shihab said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to say: Amin.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ آمِينَ ‏.‏ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ فِي السَّمَاءِ آمِينَ ‏.‏ فَوَافَقَ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Harmala ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb narrated to me. Amr informed me that Abu Yunus related to him from Abu Hurayra that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you says Amin in prayer and the angels in heaven say Amin, and one of them coincides with the other, his previous sins will be forgiven.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ بَيْنَ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَبَيْنَ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بِالَّذِي قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الآخَرُ الَّذِي لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ ‏.‏
before: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuaib ibn al-Layth narrated to me. My father narrated to me, from my grandfather. Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me. Ibn Shihab said: Ubayd Allah ibn Abdullah ibn Utba ibn Masud informed me that Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became very ill and his pain intensified, he asked his wives for permission to be cared for in my house, and they gave him permission. He went out between two men, his feet dragging on the ground, between Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib and another man. Ubayd Allah said: I told Abdullah about what Aisha said, and Abdullah ibn Abbas said to me: Do you know who the other man was whom Aisha did not name? I said: No. Ibn Abbas said: It was Ali.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَهَبَ إِلَى بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ لِيُصْلِحَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَحَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَجَاءَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ أَتُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ فَأُقِيمُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَتَخَلَّصَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ فِي الصَّفِّ فَصَفَّقَ النَّاسُ - وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ - فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرَ النَّاسُ التَّصْفِيقَ الْتَفَتَ فَرَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ امْكُثْ مَكَانَكَ فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَدَيْهِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى مَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْخَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَتَّى اسْتَوَى فِي الصَّفِّ وَتَقَدَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَثْبُتَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا كَانَ لاِبْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لِي رَأَيْتُكُمْ أَكْثَرْتُمُ التَّصْفِيقَ مَنْ نَابَهُ شَىْءٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَلْيُسَبِّحْ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا سَبَّحَ الْتُفِتَ إِلَيْهِ وَإِنَّمَا التَّصْفِيحُ لِلنِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sad al-Saidi, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went to Banu Amr ibn Awf to reconcile between them. Prayer time came, and the caller to prayer came to Abu Bakr and said: Will you lead the people in prayer while I announce its commencement? He said: Yes. Abu Bakr began the prayer. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came while the people were praying. He made his way through until he stood in the row. The people clapped, and Abu Bakr did not turn around during prayer. When the people clapped repeatedly, he turned and saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) gestured to him to remain in his place. Abu Bakr raised his hands and praised Allah for the instruction the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had given him. Then Abu Bakr stepped backward until he was level with the row, and the Prophet (peace be upon him) stepped forward and prayed. When he finished, he said: O Abu Bakr, what prevented you from remaining when I instructed you? Abu Bakr said: It was not fitting for Ibn Abi Quhafa to pray in front of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Why did I see you clapping so much? Whoever encounters something in his prayer should say tasbih, for when he says tasbih, attention will be drawn to him. Clapping is only for women.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيَنْتَهِيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ يَرْفَعُونَ أَبْصَارَهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ أَوْ لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Let those people who raise their eyes toward the sky in prayer stop doing so, or their eyes will not return to them.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيَنْتَهِيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ عَنْ رَفْعِهِمْ أَبْصَارَهُمْ عِنْدَ الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ أَوْ لَتُخْطَفَنَّ أَبْصَارُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Let people stop raising their eyes toward the sky during supplication in prayer, or their eyes will be snatched away.
